answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake bonded to verifiable past work, like quartz veins running through karst rock: cheap to claim on the surface, costly to fake at depth. An attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund every one, and misbehavior burns the stake, so the ember of a single bad act consumes its own collateral. Honest agents keep their bond and earn; fakes pay per identity, which makes large-scale forgery economically irrational.
